comment: App Links (handle_all_urls) for secretsanta.circletools.ch. The fingerprint MUST be Play's APP SIGNING key (Play Console > App integrity > App signing key certificate), NOT the upload key — Play re-signs distributed builds with the app-signing key. First entry: the app-signing key (Play tracks). Second entry: the local/upload key, so a sideloaded dev build also verifies App Links.
